comment: mon.c newcham() 5326-5338: polymorphing an ordinary monster that wears red dragon scales after red dragons are genocided. select_newcham_form() returns red dragon on every try (mon.c 5195-5200), accept_newcham_form() rejects it as G_GENOD, and after 20 tries newcham() returns 0 (5338), so the zap has no effect. A debug Valkyrie drops wished red dragon scales beside a tame djinni, which picks them up and puts them on; she reads an uncursed scroll of genocide for red dragons and zaps a wand of polymorph at the djinni twice (the first zap misses as it moves).
